items.title: Java4Shell: RCE in OpenJDK when processing Base64
items.summary: A critical remote code execution vulnerability has been identified in OpenJDK, specifically affecting how Base64 is processed. Developers should be aware of this flaw as it poses a significant risk to server security, especially for those using Java 17.

items.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
items.summary: OpenAI has launched GPT-6.2, featuring two new models, Astra and Sol, which enhance performance and usability for developers. This update is significant for engineers looking to leverage advanced AI capabilities in their applications.

items.title: Quad9's withdrawal from France: A canary in the coal mine
items.summary: Quad9's decision to withdraw its DNS services from France raises concerns about internet freedom and security in the region. Developers and engineers should consider the implications of such actions on privacy and data access.

items.title: jQuery 4.1.0 Released
items.summary: The release of jQuery 4.1.0 introduces important updates and bug fixes, enhancing the library's performance and compatibility. Web developers should review the changes to ensure their applications leverage the latest improvements.

items.title: Microsoft's ONNX Runtime has disappeared from GitHub
items.summary: The removal of Microsoft's ONNX Runtime from GitHub raises questions about the future of this important open-source project. Developers relying on ONNX for machine learning should monitor this situation closely for potential impacts on their workflows.
